setup_speech_to_text_task: setup a SpeechToTextTask by loading the target dictionary from a manifest root path and config YAML
build_s2t_generator: build a sequence generator for speech-to-text inference with optional dual decoder and multitask support
load_s2t_dataset: load a speech-to-text dataset from TSV manifest files for a given train or validation split
run_s2t_train_step: run a training step for speech-to-text with dynamic multitask loss weight updates per task
build_ctc_viterbi_decoder: build a W2lViterbiDecoder generator for CTC-based speech recognition inference via DummyMultiTask
